moves.text: Offer MoneyMertz: Roschon Johnson + Courtland Sutton for Rome Odunze.
Pick up Tyrone Tracy off waivers (+1.9 points a week) and drop Treylon Burks.

reasons: You're 8-4 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 17%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 28% of the time with the first-round bye and 11% without it. You get the bye in 37% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 2nd of 8 contenders (183.6 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (9th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 17%, 18%, 14%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 17% to 20%, and your lineup comes out 1.2 points a week ahead overall. Roschon Johnson + Courtland Sutton add 2.1 points a week for you today, but Rome Odunze is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,480, get 4,439), though it costs their lineup 1.2 a week, so expect some pushback.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 18% and 14% to 21% and 16%.
You have 7 weeks until the trade deadline.
